issue.title: ipc: AddressSanitizer: SEGV on unknown address
issue.body:
Happens [here](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/a8b69bdeafdf7993ad42aa93a80d5fc938aef1cb/src/ipc/libmultiprocess/include/mp/proxy.h#L289) when:
- client creates block template
- client calls `destroy` so the node drops the pointer to the template
- client calls method on the template

I'm no ipc expert and have no idea if this has been discussed / disregarded somewhere else.

<details>
<summary>ASAN log</summary>
